goal: Decide the minimal return contract for a future EntryFieldWriteAdapter without implementing the adapter, TUI integration, or value writes

guide_delta.summary: Der spätere Feld-Adapter soll zunächst genau das bereits vorhandene FieldDefinition zurückgeben. Dadurch entsteht kein zusätzliches Ergebnisobjekt und noch keine neue Anzeige- oder Wertlogik.

tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
TUI tests because runtime and adapters are untouched
browser tests because web code is untouched
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: returning FieldDefinition keeps the adapter seam coupled to the existing domain type, but avoids inventing a duplicate create-result model before a real consumer exists
a later TUI integration must still decide its own presentation mapping and must not treat this decision as permission to expose FieldDefinition directly in the runtime
MONEY and choice-specific UI/value semantics remain outside this return-contract decision
expected_side_effects: I54 may implement a thin EntryFieldWriteAdapter that delegates create_entry_field and returns the resulting FieldDefinition unchanged
I55 remains responsible for any later presentation mapping or TUI integration decision
